author: ClubberNugget
body:
I like the idea of it and all but i only think one mini server is necessary, there are only 4 maps and it is also limiting regular maps to 2 rotations, which will get boring really fast.  I liked having 4 different rotations to choose from, now there are only 2.  So I think we should:

A:
Remove a mini rot and replace it with a regular one or

B:
Add another regular Rot.

Thanks
-Bacon
